items.name: agent-queue-demo
items.title: Agent Queue Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/agent-queue. A static agent board with sample lanes: two busy agents, one waiting on people, one idle and offline, filtered to the viewer or everyone.

items.name: agent-run-history-demo
items.title: Run History Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/agent-run-history. Sample runs on one issue in the side-column log, with the all-runs dialog, a live run's timer, and stop and retry callbacks.

items.name: agent-composer-demo
items.title: Agent Composer Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/agent-composer. The side-panel box carrying page context as removable chips, the full-page box sending after a short wait, files added from the paperclip, a paste or a drop and uploaded before sending, and a switch that turns the empty box's send button into Stop while the agent works.

items.name: agent-picker-demo
items.title: Agent Picker Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/agent-picker. Choosing who a new conversation goes to from agents grouped by mode, an existing conversation whose agent stays, and the availability dot, mode tag and a toolbar picker on their own.

items.name: agent-chat-demo
items.title: Agent Chat Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/agent-chat. An application shell wired the way the block expects: ChatProvider around the routes, the header button, the panel beside <main> in a relative flex row, the floating button, a page that registers its issue as context with an Ask agent button, and a full-page conversation route.

items.name: auth-forms-demo
items.title: Auth Forms Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/auth-forms. The four password forms switching between each other through their links, each wired to a fake submission that waits and then fails or succeeds.

items.name: auth-methods-demo
items.title: Auth Methods Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/auth-methods. Password and LDAP sign-in in tabs with single sign-on providers below them, as text buttons for two providers and icon buttons for four.

items.name: auth-centered-layout-demo
items.title: Auth Centered Layout Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/auth-centered-layout. A sign-in page in the centered layout: brand, title and description per view, the methods and forms, and a footer.

items.name: auth-split-layout-demo
items.title: Auth Split Layout Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/auth-split-layout. A sign-in page in the split layout, with the application's own content as the aside.

items.name: device-approval-demo
items.title: Device Approval Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/device-approval. The /device page inside auth-centered-layout, keeping the user code in state. It calls the authentication plugin's client for real, so it needs the server wiring device-approval's docs list.

items.name: permission-editor-demo
items.title: Permission Editor Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/permission-editor. A role's sample permissions: pages, business actions with levels, and settings, kept in local state.

items.name: page-container-demo
items.title: Page Container Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/page-container. A page framed by PageContainer, with a PageHeader and cards as its sections.

items.name: page-header-demo
items.title: Page Header Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/page-header. PageHeader with a title alone, with a description, and with page-level actions.

items.name: settings-dialog-demo
items.title: Settings Dialog Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/settings-dialog. An account settings dialog with grouped categories, switching the open one through activeId and onSelect.

items.name: route-dialog-demo
items.title: Route Dialog Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/route-dialog. An orders page whose child routes open a RouteDialog (new, edit), a RouteDrawer (an order) and a RouteChildPage (report).

items.name: route-drawer-demo
items.title: Route Drawer Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/route-drawer. An orders page whose child routes open a RouteDialog (new, edit), a RouteDrawer (an order) and a RouteChildPage (report).

items.name: route-child-page-demo
items.title: Route Child Page Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/route-child-page. An orders page whose child routes open a RouteDialog (new, edit), a RouteDrawer (an order) and a RouteChildPage (report).

items.name: kanban-demo
items.title: Kanban Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/kanban. A task board in local state, applying each onMove to the items and announcing the last move.

items.name: property-fields-demo
items.title: Property Fields Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/property-fields. A record's property card with every field kind, each change applied to local state.

items.name: rich-text-editor-demo
items.title: Rich Text Editor Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/rich-text-editor. The editor with sample Markdown, @mention search, fake uploads, an extension of its own and a live Markdown preview.

items.name: markdown-view-demo
items.title: Markdown View Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/markdown-view. Sample Markdown with mentions, a table and fenced code rendered as compact prose.

items.name: comment-thread-demo
items.title: Comment Thread Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/comment-thread. An activity line of sample threads and custom entries with every action answered in local state, the text drawn by markdown-view.

items.name: attachment-list-demo
items.title: Attachment List Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/attachment-list. Sample images and files as a list and as a panel taking fake uploads and confirming removals.

items.name: issue-table-demo
items.title: Issue Table Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/issue-table. Sample issues in the table, sorted and selected through its callbacks.

items.name: issue-card-demo
items.title: Issue Card Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/issue-card. Sample issues as framed rows that link, plain rows in a list with marks and a remove action, cards that select, and loading skeletons.

items.name: plan-card-demo
items.title: Plan Card Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/plan-card. Three plans read through the projects plugin's hooks: one waiting for the viewer, whose risky rows ask again before executing and whose rows open in the editor, one executed that can still be undone after a preview, and one whose execution failed.

items.name: issue-detail-demo
items.title: Issue Detail Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/issue-detail. A sample issue's page composed from the parts: the body, the add bar, the secondary parts as sections (one of the page's own among them) and files dropped on the body, with property-fields, markdown-view and attachment-list, every change applied to local state.

items.name: project-detail-demo
items.title: Project Detail Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/project-detail. A sample project's page composed from the parts in tabs, with property-fields and markdown-view, every change applied to local state; each working directory links to its settings page in a memory router.

items.name: inbox-demo
items.title: Inbox Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/inbox. The /inbox page with an InboxSource over sample data that marks deployment requests as decisions, and a renderer that words them and approves or rejects them with DecisionActionsBar, and sample plans as a kind of their own whose detail uses the same InboxDetailHeader; the items themselves come from the in-app notification plugin.

items.name: inbox-button-demo
items.title: Inbox Button Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/inbox-button. The button in a full-width application header beside a search button and an avatar, with labelled state presets that set both counts: decisions waiting in amber, 99+, only unread items, and nothing, the tab title prefixed by the badge.

items.name: approval-ui-demo
items.title: Approval UI Demo
items.description: Usage example of @nocobase/approval-ui. One expense claim mapped for display: its progress through the manager, finance and the CFO with the count of answers, its history with bookkeeping folded, the route a new claim would take, a purchase's parallel branches, a notice's receipts, and the action bar with a comment form.
